Name: Monster Furniture Drop
Author: FistOfTheNoob
Description:
Introducing [b]Monster Furniture Drop[/b]: Monsters now have a chance to drop furniture when defeated! Customize drop rates globally, per monster, and per furniture item, including modded pieces. Enjoy fully adjustable, weighted drop chances and optionally disable Robin’s furniture catalogue to spice up your time deep in the dungeons!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yZ5AKJi.png[/img]﻿﻿
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] ﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url] to easily edit drop rates
[*]Download this mod, unzip it, and place the folder with its contents in your /Mods folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ba9UwAA.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Unique event furniture items will [b]not [/b]drop from monsters.
[*][b]To change all the multipliers in Monster or Item tab at the same time, adjust the "Default Monster/Item" slider, press Save & Exit, then press Default button.[/b]
[*]﻿The [u]Global Drop Chance[/u] determines the probability of furniture dropping
[*]The [u]Monster Multiplier[/u] is multiplied by the global drop chance - If the Global Drop Chance is 1% and the Monster Multiplier is 100%, we convert these numbers to decimal and multiply, .01 x 1.0 and we get 0.01. Then we convert that number back to a % by multiplying it by 100 and get 1%.
[*]The [u]Item Multipliers[/u] are weighted drop chances, the higher one item is over another the more likely it will drop when an item is dropped. This number won't increase the chance of items dropping, only the chance of certain items dropping more than others. 
[*]If the Global Drop Chance is 1% after multiplied by Monster Multiplier, and every vanilla furniture item has a weighted 100% chance to drop except one that is 50%, if you kill 1000 monsters you will have approximately 1.3% chance of that specific item dropping.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/S5wzqHM.png[/img]﻿﻿
